title: Apple Updates App Store Rules to Ban AI Nudify Apps
excerpt: Apple updates its App Store guidelines to explicitly ban AI-powered apps that generate nonconsensual intimate images.
body_html:
Apple has updated its App Store guidelines to specifically target and ban artificial intelligence applications known as "nudify" apps. These tools use AI to generate intimate images of individuals without their consent.

The policy update follows widespread criticism directed at Apple earlier this year. Users on the social media platform X utilized Grok to produce nonconsensual, sexualized deepfakes, which included images of minors. Despite the backlash, Apple did not remove the X app or Grok from the App Store at the time.

The revised rules aim to provide clearer restrictions against apps that create or facilitate nonconsensual digital harassment and the generation of unauthorized intimate content using artificial intelligence technology.
